text:
The river carves the canyon, slow and relentless.  A single drop is insignificant, yet the river's journey writes a story on the stone.

What makes a tapestry rich with color, its threads woven into a story untold? Is it the beauty of a single hue, or the symphony of many?

The moon reflects the sun's light, yet holds its own allure.

What holds meaning, then, in this tapestry of existence? The answer whispers on the wind, carried on the wings of a butterfly. Seek the answer not in the singular, but in the interconnected, the ever-changing dance of the cosmos.
